section.content: 本申请涉及锂离子电池隔膜材料领域，更具体地说，它涉及一种锂离子电池隔膜用水性粘结剂。包括颗粒状聚合物A和颗粒状聚合物B，颗粒状聚合物A的玻璃化转变温度小于颗粒状聚合物B的玻璃化转变温度，颗粒状聚合物A的颗粒度D50为0.05‑1.0μm，颗粒状聚合物B的颗粒度D10为1.0‑5.0μm，D50为2.0‑10μm，D90为3.0‑20μm。本申请的水性粘结剂具有粘接强度高的优点，并且采用本水性粘结剂制得的复合隔膜透气度好，易于收卷储存。

The application relates to the field of lithium ion battery diaphragm materials, in particular to an aqueous binder for a lithium ion battery diaphragm. Comprises a granular polymer A and a granular polymer B, wherein the glass transition temperature of the granular polymer A is lower than that of the granular polymer B, the granularity D50 of the granular polymer A is 0.05-1.0 mu m, the granularity D10 of the granular polymer B is 1.0-5.0 mu m, the granularity D50 is 2.0-10 mu m, and the granularity D90 is 3.0-20 mu m. The water-based binder has the advantage of high bonding strength, and the composite membrane prepared by the water-based binder has good air permeability and is easy to roll and store.

Aqueous binder for lithium ion battery diaphragmTechnical Field

The application relates to the field of lithium ion battery diaphragm materials, in particular to an aqueous binder for a lithium ion battery diaphragm.

Background

Lithium ion batteries have been widely used in small-sized portable devices such as smart phones, notebook computers, electric tools, and the like, and in medium-sized and large-sized energy storage devices such as electric vehicles, aerospace vehicles, power stations, and the like, because of their advantages such as high energy density, wide temperature range, many cycle times, and long storage life.

The lithium ion battery generally mainly comprises a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a diaphragm, an electrolyte and a battery shell, wherein the diaphragm is one of key inner layer components and mainly plays a role in separating the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the battery and preventing the positive electrode and the negative electrode from being contacted to form a short circuit. The current diaphragm used in lithium ion battery is polyolefin porous membrane, because the melting point of the polyolefin porous membrane is lower than 200 ℃, when the temperature of the battery is increased due to internal or external factors, the polyolefin porous membrane can shrink or melt, thereby causing direct contact between the positive electrode and the negative electrode, causing short circuit of the battery, and further causing accidents such as battery combustion and explosion.

In recent years, in order to improve the energy density of the battery, the compaction density of the positive electrode and the negative electrode is also improved to be close to the limit, and the expansion of the electrode plate, particularly the negative electrode, can cause the deformation of the battery during the charging and discharging cycles, thereby seriously affecting the safety and the reliability of the battery. On the other hand, along with the improvement of the battery capacity, the area, the volume and the weight of the battery are also larger and larger, and the battery core is often deformed and fluffy even cannot enter the shell due to loose internal structure and low mechanical strength of the battery core in the production process of the battery.

In order to solve the above problem, studies have been made to coat inorganic particles on the surface of a separator substrate with a polymer binder to form a composite separator, for example, to coat ceramic particles on the surface of a separator substrate to form a ceramic/polymer composite separator, and it is desired to reduce thermal shrinkage of the separator by using heat resistance of the ceramic particles and to improve adhesion between the composite separator and an electrode sheet interface by using the polymer binder, thereby achieving the purposes of preventing short circuit between the positive and negative electrodes of the battery and improving the hardness of the battery cell.

Therefore, the adhesion between the interface of the composite diaphragm and the electrode plate has great influence on the hardness of the battery cell, but the adhesion of the adhesive produced on the market at present is not high, and the adhesion strength of the composite diaphragm and the electrode plate is not high.

Disclosure of Invention

In order to solve the problem that the bonding effect of the binder for the lithium ion battery diaphragm is poor, the application provides the aqueous binder for the lithium ion battery diaphragm.

The application provides a water-based binder for lithium ion battery diaphragm, which adopts the following technical scheme:

an aqueous binder for a lithium ion battery separator, comprising a particulate polymer A and a particulate polymer B, wherein the glass transition temperature of the particulate polymer A is lower than that of the particulate polymer B, the particle size D50 of the particulate polymer A is 0.05-1.0 [ mu ] m, the particle size D10 of the particulate polymer B is 1.0-5.0 [ mu ] m, the D50 is 2.0-10 [ mu ] m, and the D90 is 3.0-20 [ mu ] m.

By adopting the technical scheme, the glass transition temperature of the granular polymer A is lower than that of the granular polymer B, and the granular polymer A has smaller grain size and large specific surface area, so that the granular polymer B, inorganic particles and other components can be effectively bonded to the diaphragm base material, and the bonding effect is improved; the larger particle size of the granular polymer B can prevent the composite diaphragm materials from being adhered at normal temperature, and can also prevent the granular polymer B from being buried in the small-particle inorganic particles when being mixed and coated with the small-particle inorganic particles with the particle size smaller than that of the granular polymer B, so that the granular polymer B can fully exert the bonding effect, thereby leading the composite diaphragm to be well bonded with the electrode sheet, ensuring the bonding effect of the bonding agent, in addition, it is possible to ensure that the particulate polymer B protrudes from the inorganic particles during the battery fabrication process, thereby facilitating the bonding of the composite diaphragm and the electrode plate together through hot pressing, simplifying the production process, greatly reducing the coating cost, improving the yield, meanwhile, the existence of the granular polymer B with large particle size can also provide a buffer space for the expansion of the battery in the charge-discharge cycle process, thereby well solving the deformation problem of the battery core.

And because the particle diameters of the granular polymer A and the granular polymer B in the coating layer are different, gaps can be generated between the granular polymer A and the granular polymer B, and the air permeability of the composite diaphragm is not influenced; in addition, if the single granular polymer A with small grain size is adopted, although the grain size is small, the adhesion is facilitated, the film is easy to form, so that the transmission of lithium ions is influenced, and after the granular polymer B with large grain size is added, the granular polymer A and the granular polymer B cannot form a continuous film after hot pressing, so that the transmission of the lithium ions is not influenced, and the ionic conductivity is favorably ensured.

Preferably, the particulate polymer a has a glass transition temperature of 30 ℃ or lower, and the particulate polymer B has a glass transition temperature of 35 to 90 ℃.

By adopting the technical scheme, the glass transition temperature of the granular polymer A is controlled below 30 ℃, the granular polymer A can bond components such as granular polymer B, inorganic particles and the like to the diaphragm base material at normal temperature, the bonding property is good, the glass transition temperature of the granular polymer B is controlled to be 35-90 ℃, the granular polymer B can be softened by hot pressing in the battery manufacturing process, the bonding effect can be further improved, meanwhile, the buffer can be provided and the deformation of a battery core can be limited when the battery expands in the charging and discharging circulation process, in addition, the glass transition temperature of the granular polymer B is higher than that of the granular polymer A, the composite diaphragms manufactured at normal temperature can be prevented from being mutually adhered in rolling and storing, and the coating efficiency and the yield are improved.

Preferably, the mass ratio of the particulate polymer A to the particulate polymer B is (0.05-2.0): 1.

By controlling the mass ratio of the granular polymer A to the granular polymer B to be (0.05-2.0):1, good adhesion can be ensured, good ion conduction performance of the composite diaphragm can be ensured, the composite diaphragm can block holes when the proportion of the granular polymer A is too large, ion conduction is influenced, and insufficient adhesion between the composite diaphragm and an electrode plate can be caused when the proportion of the granular polymer B is too large.

Preferably, the swelling degree of the granular polymer A in the lithium ion battery electrolyte is 10-600%, and the swelling degree of the granular polymer B in the lithium ion battery electrolyte is 30-1500%.

Tests show that the prepared lithium ion battery has better performance under the swelling degree, and when the swelling degrees of the granular polymer A and the granular polymer B are lower than the swelling degree range, the granular polymer A and the granular polymer B are not beneficial to the infiltration and absorption of electrolyte; when the swelling degrees of the particulate polymers a and B are higher than this swelling degree range, the resulting cells undergo excessive deformation after imbibing.

Preferably, neither the particulate polymer a nor the particulate polymer B contains a fluorine element.

By adopting the technical scheme, the polymer without fluorine is adopted, so that the raw material cost of the binder is lower, toxic fluorine compounds are not generated when the battery is recycled, the battery is more environment-friendly, the recycling of the battery material is facilitated, and the resources are saved.

Preferably, the granular polymer A and the granular polymer B both comprise matrix resin, a surfactant and an initiator, and the matrix resin is one or a mixture of more of vinyl resin, polyurethane, epoxy resin, polyester, polyamide, polyimide, silane resin, phenolic resin, melamine resin, urea resin, aniline resin, ionomer resin and polycarbonate.

By adopting the technical scheme, the surfactant is used for reducing the surface tension among the components, so that the matrix resin can be well and uniformly dispersed, and the initiator is used for initiating the matrix resin monomer to carry out polymerization reaction.

Preferably, the matrix resin is one or a mixture of several of vinyl resin, polyurethane, epoxy resin and polyester.

Tests prove that the uniform microspheric resin particles can be more easily obtained from the vinyl resin, the polyurethane, the epoxy resin and the polyester, and the preparation is simple.

Preferably, the matrix resin is a vinyl resin, and the vinyl resin is obtained by homopolymerization or copolymerization of vinyl monomers.

By adopting the technical scheme, the vinyl resin is low in price and simple in processing technology, the preparation difficulty of the granular polymer A and the granular polymer B is reduced, the production efficiency and the product percent of pass are improved, and the production cost is saved.

Detailed Description

For better understanding of the present invention, the technical solutions in the embodiments of the present application will be clearly and completely described below with reference to the drawings of the embodiments of the present application. It is to be understood that the described embodiments are merely a few embodiments of the present application and not all embodiments. Based on the embodiments in the present application, other embodiments obtained by persons of ordinary skill in the art with the understanding of the inventive concepts in the present application are within the scope of the present application.

As a widely used energy storage device, a separator of a lithium ion battery is one of the key inner layer components, and is mainly used for separating the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the battery and preventing the positive electrode and the negative electrode from contacting and being short-circuited. In order to improve the energy density of the battery, the compaction density of the positive electrode and the negative electrode is also improved to be close to the limit, and the expansion of the pole piece, particularly the negative electrode, can cause the deformation of the battery in the charging and discharging circulation process, thereby seriously influencing the safety and the reliability of the battery. On the other hand, along with the improvement of the battery capacity, the area, the volume and the weight of the battery are also larger and larger, and the battery core is often deformed and fluffy due to loose internal structure and low mechanical strength of the battery core.

In order to solve the problem, at present, a polymer binder is used to coat inorganic particles on the surface of a diaphragm substrate to form a composite diaphragm, for example, a mixed coating formed by bonding ceramic particles and a polymer is coated on the surface of the diaphragm substrate to form a ceramic/polymer composite diaphragm, the heat resistance of the ceramic particles is used to reduce the thermal shrinkage of the diaphragm, and the polymer binder is used to improve the adhesion between the diaphragm and a pole piece interface, so as to achieve the purposes of preventing the short circuit of the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the battery and improving the hardness of the battery core. However, the adhesive property of the adhesive produced in the market at present is not high, and the adhesive strength of the composite diaphragm and the electrode plate is not high. According to the water-based adhesive, the granular polymers with different glass transition temperatures and particle sizes are mixed to prepare the water-based adhesive, so that the adhesive strength between the composite diaphragm and the electrode plate is greatly improved.

Examples

Example 1:

preparation of particulate Polymer A: weighing 0.64 part of surfactant and 400 parts of deionized water, adding the surfactant and the deionized water into a stirring container, adding 65 parts of ethyl acrylate, 5 parts of acrylic acid, 10 parts of acrylonitrile, 10 parts of methyl methacrylate and 10 parts of allyl methacrylate, controlling the stirring speed to be 450 +/-50 rpm, stirring and heating to 74 +/-1 ℃, then adding 1.2 parts of initiator, keeping the temperature of 74 +/-1 ℃ for stirring and reacting for 6 hours, then heating to 79 +/-1 ℃, and continuing to react for 3 hours to obtain the granular polymer A emulsion with the solid content of 20%.

Preparation of particulate Polymer B: preparation of particulate Polymer B: 60 parts of anhydrous MgSO (MgSO) are added to a stirring vessel4The powder and 340 parts of deionized water were mixed under stirring to make 15 wt.% MgSO4Adding 5 parts of surfactant, 30 parts of methyl methacrylate, 20 parts of acrylonitrile, 40 parts of ethyl acrylate and 10 parts of allyl methacrylate into 400 parts of aqueous solution, controlling the stirring speed to be 450 +/-50 rpm, stirring and heating to 80 ℃, introducing nitrogen, adding initiator, stirring and reacting for 6 hours at 80 ℃, and naturally cooling to room temperature to obtain dispersion liquid. And (3) centrifugally separating and filtering the prepared dispersion liquid by a centrifugal machine, washing a filter cake for 3 times by using deionized water, and filtering to obtain a granular polymer B. And dispersing the granular polymer B in deionized water to obtain a granular polymer B emulsion with the solid content of 20%.

Preparation of the aqueous binder: according to the particulate polymer a emulsion: and adding the two emulsions into a stirring container in a mass ratio of 0.6:1, stirring and mixing, controlling the stirring speed to be 600rpm, and stirring for 3 hours at normal temperature to obtain the aqueous binder for the lithium ion battery diaphragm.

Wherein, the surfactant adopted in the preparation of the granular polymer A is sodium dodecyl benzene sulfonate, the initiator is ammonium persulfate, the surfactant adopted in the preparation of the granular polymer B is polyvinyl alcohol (KH-20), and the initiator is benzoyl peroxide.

The following property measurements were made on the materials of examples 1-5, and the measurement data are shown in Table 1.

As can be seen from examples 1 to 5 in combination with the data in table 1, the composite separator produced using the aqueous binders formulated in the 5 groups of examples all had excellent adhesive strength and air permeability, among which the aqueous binder prepared using the formulation in example 1 had better performance, and the glass transition temperature of the granular polymer a in example 1 was 9.5 ℃, so that the granular polymer a was able to firmly bond the components such as the granular polymer B and the inorganic particles to the separator substrate at room temperature, and had good adhesion.

The glass transition temperature of the granular polymer B is 55.2 ℃, so the granular polymer B can not be softened at normal temperature, and the diaphragms prepared at normal temperature are prevented from being adhered to each other during rolling and storage. In the subsequent battery manufacturing process, the granular polymer B can be softened through hot pressing, so that the bonding effect is further improved, and the granular polymer B can provide buffering and limit the deformation of the battery core when the battery expands in the charge-discharge cycle process.

In addition, the granular polymer B has larger grain diameter than the granular polymer A, is favorable for ensuring that the composite diaphragm material is not easy to adhere at normal temperature, and can not be buried in small-grain inorganic particles when being mixed and coated with the small-grain inorganic particles with the grain diameter smaller than that of the granular polymer B, so that the granular polymer B can fully exert the adhesive action, the composite diaphragm can be well adhered to an electrode plate, and the adhesive strength between the composite diaphragm and the electrode plate can reach 1.72N/m.

The particle size D50 of the particulate polymer A in examples 2 to 5 was greater than the particle size D50 of the particulate polymer A in example 1, and the particle sizes D50 and D90 of the particulate polymer B were less than the particle sizes D50 and D90 of the particulate polymer B in example 1, so that the particle size difference between the particulate polymer A and the particulate polymer B in examples 2 to 5 was less than that in example 1, indicating that the voids between the particulate polymer A and the particulate polymer B were smaller, which adversely affected the air permeability of the subsequently prepared composite separator. It can also be seen from the data in table 1 that the air permeability of the composite membranes prepared using the aqueous binder formulations in example 1 was as high as 195s/100ml, the ionic conductivity was excellent, and the air permeability of the composite membranes prepared using the aqueous binder formulations in examples 2 to 5 was lower than that of the composite membranes prepared using the aqueous binder formulation in example 1.

And the fact that the particle size D50 of the granular polymer a in example 1 was smaller than the particle size D50 of the granular polymer a in examples 2 to 5 also demonstrated that the granular polymer a in example 1 had a larger specific surface area, and that the components such as the granular polymer B and the inorganic particles were effectively bonded to the separator substrate, and the bonding effect was improved.

In addition, in subsequent battery tests, the composite diaphragm electrolyte prepared by the aqueous binder formula in example 2, example 3, and example 5 has a slow infiltration and absorption speed, so that it can be concluded that the degree of swelling is too small to facilitate infiltration and absorption of the electrolyte, and the battery cell prepared in example 4 deforms too much after imbibing, so that it can be concluded that the prepared battery cell deforms after imbibing.

Therefore, the aqueous binder prepared by the formula in the embodiment 1 has better performance and better bonding effect, the prepared composite diaphragm and the electrode plate have higher bonding strength and better air permeability, and the composite diaphragm is not easy to bond during rolling and is convenient to store. And when the composite membrane is prepared, organic solvents such as NMP, acetone and ethanol which are needed in the traditional process are not needed to be used for preparing the coating for multiple times of coating, inorganic particles and the membrane base material can be bonded together through the granular polymer A with smaller particle size only by one-time coating, and the composite membrane and the electrode plate are bonded together through the granular polymer B with larger particle size, so that the process is simple, the yield is high, and the environment is basically free of pollution.
